summary: A lookout tree with a platform on Blue Mountain in Modoc County; its 1940s history is documented, both FFLA lists still mark it Standing, and no dated source after 1948 covers its condition.

facts.design: Lookout tree with a platform built on top (National Geodetic Survey description, 1948)

events.note: Warner Mountain District maintenance plan calls the tree and platform unsafe after about ten years of use and suggests a 20-foot tower
National Geodetic Survey station description: lookout tree about 40 feet high with a platform built on top

evidence.supports: Tree and platform used about ten years, unsafe; 20-foot tower suggested (1945)
evidence.quote: A lookout tower on the East Point of Blue Mountain is mandatory this year as the tree and platform used for the past ten years is unsafe for men to use.
We suggest a 20-foot steel (if possible) or wood tower

evidence.supports: The 1945 item is from the Warner Mountain District maintenance plan
NGS 1948 description: tree about 40 feet high, platform on top
evidence.quote: LOOKOUT TREE IS ABOUT 40 FEET HIGH AND HAS A PLATFORM BUILT ON TOP.
DESCRIBED BY COAST AND GEODETIC SURVEY 1948

evidence.supports: Agency is the Modoc National Forest
Statewide list entry for the tree: Modoc, Tree, Standing, no register
evidence.quote: Blue Mountain Tree (East Peak) Modoc 41.82895 -120.85218 Tree Standing

evidence.supports: County list entry for the tree reads Tree, Standing, with no register
Separate Blue Mountain tower, about 0.97 km from the tree by its coordinates; listed Standing with register US 1329, CA 152
evidence.quote: Modoc Blue Mountain 41.83017 -120.86377 Tower Standing NHLR US 1329, CA 152

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register number US 1329, CA 152 belongs to a separate Blue Mountain tower listed nearby, not to the East Peak tree, whose county-list entry shows no register.

Both FFLA lists read Standing for the tree, with no register number. The Gone entries near Blue Mountain in those lists belong to other lookouts, such as the Kern County Blue Mountain (Encl. Tower, Gone).

notes_for_editor: Status: both FFLA lists read Standing for the tree (statewide list: Blue Mountain Tree (East Peak); county list: Modoc, Tree Standing). An earlier reading that the statewide list said Gone was wrong; the Gone rows nearby belong to other lookouts. No dated source after 1948 for the tree itself. Record height_m 6.1 (20 ft) matches the 1945 proposed tower, not the 1948 NGS description of a tree about 40 ft; not corrected, needs a human look. The NGS text is quoted on the Forest Lookouts page, not read from NGS. Two web searches found nothing usable about this tree (results were other Blue Mountains and an unrelated Modoc tower). No staffing or fire history found. No photos. Do not encourage climbing.
